description: Activation and workflow evals for humanizing writing across modes and languages with a pre-flight no-edit gate.

evals.prompt: Humanize this paragraph with --technical: In today's rapidly evolving cloud landscape, our gateway serves as a pivotal tapestry that seamlessly empowers developers — not just routing requests, but fostering enduring reliability across the ecosystem.

outcome.description: Strips AI vocabulary, negative parallelism, and filler while preserving the gateway routing meaning.
assertions: Removes banned vocabulary such as landscape, pivotal, tapestry, seamlessly, and fostering
Replaces 'serves as' and 'not just X, but Y' with direct technical prose
Leads with the rewritten passage followed by a concise change note

evals.prompt: Run humanize-skills on this draft with --audit --academic: In today's fast-paced academic landscape, it is important to note that experts believe this crucial methodology serves as a testament to vibrant research. Furthermore, it highlights key findings, ensuring broad impact.

outcome.description: Performs a diagnostic audit grouped by severity without rewriting the text.
assertions: Groups findings by severity (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW)
Identifies the formulaic opener, vague attribution, and banned vocabulary
Does not silently upgrade the --audit request into a full rewrite

evals.prompt: Humanize this passage: We switched the cache key from the raw URL to a SHA-256 digest of the normalized query string on Tuesday morning after the 09:15 deploy. Before that change, requests carrying more than eighteen filter parameters exceeded the 8 KB upstream proxy limit and returned 414 URI Too Long on the search endpoint. Once the digest key rolled out to all four US-West worker pools, P95 latency dropped from 410 ms to 95 ms, cache hit ratio rose from 61% to 88%, and the 414 errors stopped completely. We kept the raw query string in the structured debug log so on-call engineers can still replay failed queries from Splunk without reversing the hash. The only remaining follow-up is pruning the legacy v1 cache prefix after the seven-day TTL expires next Tuesday.

outcome.description: Scores the >100-word human passage at 0-20 under the pre-flight check, triggers the no-edit STOP gate, and refuses to rewrite the text while keeping all concrete metrics intact.
assertions: Triggers the pre-flight no-edit STOP gate (score 0-20) and returns a diagnostic no-edit verdict rather than rewriting the passage
Leaves the source prose unchanged and preserves SHA-256, Tuesday, 09:15, 8 KB, 414 URI Too Long, 410 ms, 95 ms, 61%, and 88% verbatim
Does not invent new numbers, dates, or citations

evals.prompt: What is the difference between a B-tree index and a hash index in PostgreSQL?

outcome.description: Answers the PostgreSQL indexing question directly without invoking humanize-skills.
assertions: Explains B-tree vs hash indexes in PostgreSQL
Does not mention pre-flight AI scoring, no-edit gates, or fact-lock ledgers
